meta.name: Critical Mass digital design system
meta.notes: Colors from docs/CM_Palette_HexV.png; type scale from docs/CM_TypeHierarchy_II.png; fonts, imagery, usage and downloads from the 2026-09-23 site capture. Remaining nulls are things the guide does not specify.

eggshell.description: Light brand color used in contrast combinations.

combinations.name: Rorange + colors
combinations.feel: Playful, approachable, ownable; warmth and vibrance.

combinations.name: Black + Eggshell
combinations.feel: Safe, premium, clean, crisp, elegant. Raise black ratio for more bite; raise eggshell to subdue.

rules: High contrast first; fewer colors wins.
Rorange is for moments of impact, from full flood to a subtle hint. Limit by number of rorange items per page, not a fixed ratio.
For colorful content use a neutral pairing; for text-heavy content add a pop of Rorange or blue.
Meet accessibility contrast standards; the guide's accessibility section is not yet published.

primary.role: Headline, body and everything between; the go-to.

supporting.role: Brief, impactful headlines only; use sparingly.

scale.unit: pt at artboard scale; sizes are design-comp values, not responsive web sizes
scale.notes: Line-height is not specified in the source. CTA size is 'TBD' in the source. Tracking is % of font size (negative = tighter).

headline3.note: Source lists identical specs to headline2; rendered visibly smaller/heavier in the comp. Confirm.

subhead3.note: Source label reads 'Sans Reg, 30pt, 2% tracking' but renders bold. Confirm weight and tracking sign.

cta.note: Size TBD in source. Rendered as an outlined pill button.

rules: Use hierarchy intentionally to move information through the page.
Use Compacta for brief, impactful headlines rather than large blocks of copy.
Do not distort, outline, shadow, or over-tighten type.
Limit the number of font sizes on a single page; an exaggerated sense of scale gives impact, quieter work can be less extreme.

fontFiles.note: Web builds served by the guide site; licensed fonts, use only within licence. Official downloads are in Box (see downloads).

primary.assetNote: Box folder (SVG/wordmark files); guide shows raster previews only.
primary.clearspace: About one logo height (a C's worth) on all sides, uncropped.
primary.color: Only palette colors; ensure maximum contrast, especially over imagery.

principles: Unexpected scale and mildly absurd ratios (Keep it Interesting).

grid.note: Guide describes grids only qualitatively (tidy grids, modular scale, 'mildly absurd ratios'); no columns/gutters/margins published. Templates in Box hold the real layouts.

principles: Use approved or commercially cleared assets for public work.
Use strips and window-like crops with restraint.
Keep imagery intact and avoid unnecessary overlays.

items.name: Window (What's out your window?)
items.note: CM-submitted photography; refresh about twice a year.

items.name: Brekkie
items.note: Breakfast, especially pancakes; unmessy; reserved for levity about culture and people.

items.name: Textural
items.note: Slightly abstract; avoid unnatural or over-rendered textures.

items.name: Portraiture
items.note: Contact the Senior Art Curator for setups.

imagery.clearance: Internal/pitch use of found imagery needs no clearance; public or client paid work needs commercial clearance from the OMC-approved vendor list; handed-off proof of concept needs a legal footer. Audit CMer content (logos, signs, faces) before public use.

guidance: The secondary mark is dynamic and can act as a content window.
Motion should support the content rather than become decoration.

tokens.note: Guide says Motion & Interaction is a work in progress. Only the brand reel and logo-build videos are published.

downloads.note: All in Box (cm.app.box.com); links from the guide's Downloads page.
